content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned system for selling digital products. It’s not a plugin or a third-party service. It’s a combination of free and paid tools that you control entirely. The core problem it solves is payment exclusion. Stripe and PayPal block entire countries, including Nigeria, due to regulatory or risk assessments. Teachable and similar platforms depend on these payment processors, so they fail too. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this by using on-chain crypto payments. Buyers send payment directly to your wallet. The system verifies the transaction and delivers the product automatically. No middleman. No platform. No rejection. This isn’t about avoiding fees—it’s about structural access. You own the store, the payment flow, and the delivery mechanism. It’s commerce infrastructure built for permanence, not permission.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Edge Commerce Stack uses Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. Here’s the flow: A buyer visits your store, selects a product, and pays in crypto. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and sends a webhook to Cloudflare Workers. The worker logs the order in Supabase, checks payment status, and generates a secure download link from Cloudflare R2. The buyer receives the link instantly. Every component is stateless and serverless. You don’t manage servers or databases. Cloudflare’s edge network ensures low latency globally. Supabase handles order data with end-to-end encryption. The stack is deployed in 48 hours, fully configured with SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability. You own the codebase and data. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell courses, ebooks, templates, or software and your audience can’t pay you through Stripe or PayPal, this is your solution. It’s not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent alternative. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for creators who value ownership over convenience. You don’t rent infrastructure; you own it. There are no subscriptions or recurring fees. Once deployed, the system operates independently. It’s also built for scalability. The stack handles up to 10,000 transactions per month without additional cost. If you’re tired of being locked out of global commerce, this is how you take control. It’s not just about selling—it’s about building a system that can’t be taken away.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure removes middlemen entirely—no platform dependency.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront for free, with global CDN distribution. Cloudflare Workers execute backend logic, handling payments and order processing without servers. Supabase stores order data securely, with built-in authentication and encryption. Cloudflare R2 delivers files with high availability and low cost. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer account required. The stack is configured with SPF/DKIM/DMARC to ensure email deliverability for order confirmations. Each component is chosen for its reliability and cost-efficiency. Cloudflare’s edge network ensures fast performance globally. Supabase’s Postgres database is scalable and secure. NOWPayments supports low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON, keeping transaction costs under $0.10. The entire stack is open-source and fully documented. You own the codebase and can modify it as needed.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by purchasing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. COREMERCH deploys the stack in 48 hours, fully configured with your products and payment details. You provide the course files, pricing, and branding. The team handles the technical setup, including DNS configuration, payment integration, and email setup. After deployment, you receive full access to the codebase and documentation. You can add new products, update pricing, or modify the storefront using the provided templates. The stack includes 30 days of support for any issues or questions. This isn’t a SaaS product—it’s a deployed system. Once live, it operates independently, with no ongoing fees or dependencies. You own it. You control it. You scale it.

No. The stack uses serverless architecture with Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. You don’t manage servers, databases, or infrastructure. Everything is handled automatically.
